title: Text-path boundaries: furniture filter (headers/footers/page numbers) and passage intro/heading after option D (design 43.1, REQ-0045)

design.summary: pdf furniture filter (first/last 2 lines repeated on >=3 pages or page-number patterns) and segment: group passage/part heading after option D opens a pending context instead of gluing to D
risks: a real repeated page-top line removed

implementation.summary: pdf page furniture filter (page numbers, repeated first/last-2 header/footer lines, Page n of m) with info warning; segment group-intro/part heading after option D opens a pending context (vi/en, line-start anchored)

unit_test.result: 707 run, 30+ new pass, 3 known failures identical at base; tester classifier on real DGNL text: 126 questions unchanged, 18 lose a page-number token, 14 passage moved from D, 0 unexplained; 4 mutations caught; D1-D3 tests fail on base
